title: Three Astounding Facts About Voyager 1!

scenes.text: Voyager 1 has traveled over 14 billion miles since launch!

scenes.label: FIRST INTERSTELLAR PRO
scenes.text: Voyager 1 is the first human-made object to enter interstellar space.

scenes.label: GOLDEN RECORD MESSAGE
scenes.text: It carries a Golden Record with sounds and images of Earth.

scenes.label: DATA TRANSMISSION
scenes.text: Voyager 1 sends data from over 14 billion miles away, taking over 21 hours to reach Earth.
Follow for daily science that blows your mind.

description: Voyager 1 continues to amaze us with its achievements in space exploration. Follow for daily science!
